evals.prompt: I've been building a SaaS app for two weeks and have zero docs. Run retroprd on this repo at /tmp/retroprd-eval-repo. I want the full treatment — PRDs, scaffold files, everything.
evals.expected_output: PRDs in .prd/ numbered from 001, a .prd/README.md index, .context/session.md, .context/backlog.md, .dev/decisions.md, and a RetroPRD Complete summary. Every PRD must have a Reconstruction confidence marker. If there are uncommitted changes before writing, the agent must ask the user first. The summary must include a git commit and push reminder.
assertions: At least one PRD file is created in .prd/ with .md extension
Each PRD includes a 'Reconstruction confidence' field set to High, Medium, or Low
.prd/README.md is created or updated with a table listing all generated PRDs
.context/session.md is created and contains a 'Current product state' section
.context/backlog.md is created with at least one backlog entry
.dev/decisions.md is created with at least one ADR entry
A 'RetroPRD Complete' summary is delivered at the end with coverage date range and confidence breakdown
Agent runs git status before writing any documentation files
If uncommitted changes are present before writing, agent asks the user whether to commit first
Agent runs 'git log -1' and 'git status' after delivering the summary
A reminder to run git commit and git push appears at the end of the output

evals.prompt: I just want PRDs from my git history at /tmp/retroprd-eval-repo — no scaffold files. I already have my AGENTS.md set up.
evals.expected_output: PRD files written to .prd/ and .prd/README.md updated. No .context/ or .dev/ files created. Final summary notes that scaffold generation was skipped. A git commit and push reminder is included.
assertions: At least one PRD file is created in .prd/
.prd/README.md is created or updated
No file is created at .context/session.md
No file is created at .context/backlog.md
No file is created at .dev/decisions.md
Agent runs git status before writing any PRD files
A reminder to run git commit and git push appears at the end of the output

evals.prompt: My AGENTS.md at /tmp/retroprd-eval-repo/AGENTS.md has a bunch of TODO sections. Can you read the repo history and fill them in?
evals.expected_output: AGENTS.md updated with project context (3+ sentences), identified build phases, current focus, key learnings/gotchas, and active backlog. No PRD files created. A git commit and push reminder is included after the changes.
assertions: AGENTS.md is modified and no longer contains TODO placeholder sections
The updated AGENTS.md contains a project context description of at least 3 sentences
The updated AGENTS.md identifies at least 2 build phases
The updated AGENTS.md has a key learnings or gotchas section with at least one entry
No new PRD files are created in .prd/
Agent runs git status before modifying AGENTS.md
If uncommitted changes are present before writing, agent asks the user whether to commit first
A reminder to run git commit and git push appears at the end of the output
